integrity: Exact formulas and universal proofs supplied; finite rational checker corroborates but is not a substitute for proof. Literature priority is qualified, independent scientific audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform measure, two nonempty parts each size at least two, cross distance one and same-part distance t in [1,2], real scalar maps or real Hilbert targets with dimension at least N-1. Does not determine low-dimensional restricted Hilbert targets. Earlier polyhedral classification, isometric embedding threshold and scalar graph endpoint are prior art.
title: Exact scalar–Hilbert Lipschitz variance on two-distance bipartite metrics
